author: arcprize
summary: ARC Prize announced Tufa Labs’ 88.06% ARC-AGI-2 public score and said the bonus pool would be shared among teams scoring above 85%.
whyItMatters: A major public-board milestone; final award eligibility still follows the competition rules.

author: arcprize
summary: ARC Prize announced Yi-Chia Chen’s 59.17% ARC-AGI-3 public score and her lead over Tufa Labs.
whyItMatters: The organizer’s announcement supplies context for the lead change; the next edition checks fresh standings.

author: MindsAI_Jack
summary: Jack Cole congratulated Tufa Labs on the ARC-AGI-2 milestone, quoting Mike Knoop’s reaction.
whyItMatters: A contender’s respectful response adds the people behind the leaderboard to the story.

author: fchollet
summary: Chollet welcomed the improving ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle scores while quoting ARC Prize’s Tufa Labs announcement.
whyItMatters: A public reaction from ARC’s co-founder, tied to the original result rather than an independent score claim.

author: tufalabs
summary: Tufa Labs posted an AI-made battle illustration and described the ARC-3 reversal as a temporary setback, with a playful pledge to overwhelm competitors with compute.
whyItMatters: The image inspired the Digest’s friendly rabbit-and-GPU-spider callback; it is banter, not hardware evidence.
